sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: [FORMULA] MainShape sh:sparql and required input properties: The candidate omits the required canonical shipSizeEngineOutputCoefficientK input and incorrectly uses continuousPropulsionPowerAvailableInIce directly as the k operand in c_d=(a*k+b)/1000. Required change: Add exactly one required unitless shipSizeEngineOutputCoefficientK quantity input owned by the ship, bind its numeric value as ?k, and compute rawCd=(?a * ?k + ?b) / 1000.
